prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-28, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-28):
| Current ratio           | 0.92 |
| Retained earnings       | -8,881M |
| Current liabilities     | 11,449M |
| Current assets          | 10,559M |
| Shareholders' equity    | -8,465M |
| Total liabilities       | 39,015M |
| Total assets            | 30,558M |
| EBIT / operating income | 777M |
| Revenue                 | 9,532M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows structural solvency risk with negative equity (-8,465M) and high leverage (Total liabilities 39,015M vs Total assets 30,558M). Liquidity is weak (current ratio 0.92) and asset base insufficient to cover liabilities, indicating elevated default risk despite positive EBIT.

DECISION: CCC-
